body:
# TimExp

![Supports](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.x+-00AAFF?style=for-the-badge)
![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-00AAFF?style=for-the-badge)
![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platforms-Paper%20%7C%20Purpur%20%7C%20Spigot%20%7C%20Folia-00AAFF?style=for-the-badge)

> Now your XP bottles are private. Sneak to share them.

TimExp is a lightweight and modern Minecraft plugin that prevents players from stealing XP from your Bottles o' Enchanting.

By default, XP becomes private to the thrower.

Want to share XP with friends?  
Simply sneak while throwing the bottle.

---

## ✨ Features

- Private XP bottle pickup
- Sneak to share XP
- Lightweight & optimized
- Smart orb ownership system
- Fully configurable
- No dependencies
- Supports modern server software
- Vanilla-friendly gameplay

---

## ✅ Supported Platforms

- Paper
- Spigot
- Purpur
- Folia-friendly

## ✅ Supported Versions

1.20.x → Latest

---

## ⚙️ How It Works

### Normal Throw
Only the player who threw the XP bottle can collect the XP.

### Sneak Throw
Sneak while throwing to make the XP public and shareable.

Simple. Clean. Intuitive.

---

## 📦 Commands

```txt
/timexp
/timexp reload
/timexp info
```

---

## 🔑 Permissions

```txt
timexp.use
timexp.reload
timexp.admin
timexp.bypass
```

---

## 🚀 Why TimExp?

XP stealing is annoying especially on survival, prison, skyblock, and PvP servers.

TimExp solves this problem while keeping the vanilla Minecraft feel intact.

No complicated systems.  
No unnecessary features.  
Just a polished solution that works.

---

## 🛠️ Configuration

Fully customizable:
- XP protection duration
- ActionBar messages
- Sounds
- Particles
- Shared XP behavior

---

## ❤️ Designed For Modern Servers

TimExp is built with:
- clean architecture
- modern APIs
- high performance
- future compatibility in mind

Perfect for both small communities and large networks.

---
